name: Bias for Action
definition: Speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. Leaders value calculated risk taking.

rows.situation: When the team has to move
rows.under: Nothing gets done. Customers and peers see the group as ineffective.
rows.justRight: Takes calculated risks. Decisions are quick, and course correction is fluid. Other people want to work with them.
rows.over: Customers and peers feel steamrolled. Everything is priority one. Deadlines are missed.

rows.under: Passes the work up or leaves it sitting.
rows.justRight: Moves the work forward. Steps up and owns it.
rows.over: Tackles everything and has no sense of priority.

rows.situation: When the group agrees a change is needed
rows.under: Talks about the change and never does the action part.
rows.justRight: Names the reversible next step, takes it, and checks whether it worked.
rows.over: Fixes the local issue in a hurry and never looks at the larger picture.

rows.under: Afraid to be wrong, so overanalyzes. Says we cannot, or we have never done that. Does not roll up sleeves.
rows.justRight: Starts on the problem, even if the first move is small. Reaches across teams to learn faster. Title does not mean less work.
rows.over: Does the work at any cost. Gets a lot of the wrong things done. Never reflects, and never finishes.

rows.under: Bias for thinking, or for doing nothing.
rows.justRight: Execution is what matters. Prefers incremental progress in the right direction over waiting for a perfect plan.

rows.under: Analysis paralysis. Waits for a complete picture that will not arrive.
rows.justRight: Reads the data they have, picks a solid next step, and goes forward with a prototype.
rows.over: Takes action on a path they cannot even describe.

rows.under: Delays for weeks waiting to hear from everyone before acting.
rows.justRight: Consults the people who matter, takes an acceptable amount of risk, and moves.
rows.over: Acts with no input, and does not stop to ask whether the move is reversible.

rows.under: Waits for a ticket, an assignment, or proof it is their issue.
rows.justRight: Joins the investigation early, even when it may not be their team's bug, and does the next right thing for the customer.
rows.over: Charges in, breaks a one-way door, and creates a second incident.
